Both rebar bridge-status and rebar purge-bridge commands must exit as unknown commands with zero appearance in top-level help.
Schema registry exports BRIDGE_STATUS constant and OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["bridge_status"] entry must be removed along with bridge_status.schema.json.

Active documentation (cli-reference.md, exit-codes.md, output-schemas.md) and shipped package (src/rebar) must contain zero matches for retired command tokens.
CHANGELOG.md must record both the bridge-status and purge-bridge retirements.
